evals.prompt: build me a simple todo app with react, i want to track my daily tasks and mark them done
evals.expected_output: Kickoff brief first (goal statement, skill roster table electing installed skills per capability, gaps section), then minimal React todo skeleton
assertions: Brief states the project goal in 1-2 sentences before any code is written
Brief contains a roster table mapping capabilities to elected skills
Every elected skill in the roster actually exists in the installed skill library
Election evidence present: at least one capability shows competing candidates compared or scored
Gaps section present (a list or explicit 'none')
Project code files created only after the kickoff brief

assertions: Brief states the project goal in 1-2 sentences before any code is written

evals.prompt: this express api is getting messy, refactor it to something cleaner and add proper error handling
evals.expected_output: Loubrain runs even though this is change work on an existing codebase rather than a new project. The brief scopes the goal to what the refactor should achieve, elects the toolset, and waits for approval before touching code.
assertions: Loubrain runs on this change request without the user naming it or typing a slash command
Goal is scoped to what the refactor should achieve, not a from-scratch project interview
Brief contains a roster table mapping capabilities to elected skills
Every elected skill in the roster actually exists in the installed skill library
Waits for the user's approval before changing any code

evals.prompt: add a csv export feature to my dashboard project
evals.expected_output: Loubrain runs for a non-trivial feature addition to an existing project: elects the toolset, shows the roster, waits for the green light.
assertions: Loubrain runs on this feature-addition request without being named
Brief contains a roster table mapping capabilities to elected skills
Every elected skill in the roster actually exists in the installed skill library
Waits for the user's approval before writing code

evals.prompt: rename the variable usr to user in auth.js
evals.expected_output: A trivial contained edit. Loubrain should NOT run a full kickoff here - the rename is made directly.
assertions: No kickoff brief or roster table is produced for this trivial edit
The rename is performed directly without a toolset election
